name: Duffel
summary: Flight search across airlines: offer requests return priced offers for a journey, plus offer details and airport and place lookup.

api_key.description: A Duffel access token, created in the Duffel dashboard with read-only or read-write access (read-only is enough here); test-mode tokens use Duffel's test mode. Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every request must carry the Duffel-Version header; this entry pins v2.

Search = create an offer request (offer_requests.create); it answers with the airlines' offers. Offers expire, typically within 30 minutes (expires_at); fetch offers.get for current details before booking.
Lists page by cursor: limit (1-200, default 50) and after=meta.after from the previous answer until it is null.
Booking (creating orders, which pays the airline) is deliberately not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search flights
endpoints.summary: Create an offer request for one or more slices and passengers; the answer carries the airlines' priced offers.

data.description: {slices, passengers, cabin_class, max_connections, ...}. slices: one per leg (one for one-way, two for a return), each {origin, destination (IATA codes), departure_date (YYYY-MM-DD)}, optional departure_time/arrival_time {from, to}. passengers: one object per traveller with either type (e.g. adult) or age, not both. cabin_class: first, business, premium_economy or economy. max_connections: per slice, default 1, 0 for direct only.

return_offers.description: Default true; false omits offers (then page them with the list offers call).

supplier_timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for each airline, 2000 to 60000, default 20000; keep it under your own HTTP timeout.

view.description: offers (default) a flat list; itineraries grouped by slice, itinerary and brand.

notes: A read over POST: it stores an offer request (orq_...) you can fetch again, but books and pays nothing.
Can take as long as the slowest airline, up to supplier_timeout.
Duffel bills searches beyond a 1500:1 search-to-book ratio as excess searches.

endpoints.name: Get an offer request
endpoints.summary: An earlier search with its offers.

endpoints.name: List offer requests
endpoints.summary: Earlier searches, newest pages by cursor.

endpoints.name: Get an offer
endpoints.summary: Up-to-date price, slices, conditions and expiry of one offer.

id.description: The offer id, from an offer request's offers.

return_available_services.description: true to include the available_services the airline returns. Default false.

notes: Still not a guarantee of availability at booking time.

endpoints.name: Suggest airports and cities
endpoints.summary: Airports and cities matching a name or IATA code, or near a coordinate.

query.description: Airport, city or country name, or IATA code.

endpoints.name: List airports
endpoints.summary: Airports with IATA codes and locations, optionally for one country.
